strings.Es la declaración con la que el operador: It is the statement in which the operator declares, before placing the coffee or cocoa on the EU market or exporting it, that due diligence was carried out and that the risk is none or negligible. strings.La geolocalización de todos los establec: The geolocation of every establishment where the animals were raised: one point per establishment is enough.
strings.La madera entra en el EUDR con una lista: Wood is covered by the EUDR with a broad list: from logs and sawn timber to paper, board and furniture. From 30 December 2026 you must identify the species and the forest plot of origin, and prove there was no deforestation or forest degradation after 2020.
strings.La madera es el único producto del EUDR: Wood is the only EUDR commodity that also requires the species: common name and full scientific name. And no deforestation is not enough: there can be no forest degradation after 2020 either.
strings.La palma aceitera entra en el EUDR: desd: Oil palm is covered by the EUDR: from 30 December 2026, palm oil and palm kernel oil, their fractions and several chemical derivatives need the geolocation of the plantations the fruit came from and proof that there was no deforestation after 2020.
strings.La prueba de que ninguna se deforestó de: Proof that none of them was deforested after 31 December 2020.
strings.La prueba de que ninguno de esos estable: Proof that none of those establishments was deforested after 31 December 2020.
strings.La prueba de que no hubo deforestación n: Proof that there was no deforestation or forest degradation after 31 December 2020.
strings.La soya entra en el EUDR: desde el 30 de: Soy is covered by the EUDR: from 30 December 2026, soya beans, flour, oil and oilcake entering the EU need the geolocation of the fields where they were grown and proof that there was no deforestation after 2020.
strings.Las lenguas de bovino congeladas se exig: Frozen bovine tongues are required from 30 December 2027.
strings.Las pruebas de legalidad según las leyes: Proof of legality under the laws of the country of production, such as the right to use the land.
strings.Los derivados que se suman, como los jab: The derivatives that join, such as soaps, are required from 30 December 2027.
strings.Los libros, periódicos y demás impresos: Books, newspapers and other printed matter (chapter 49) left the annex with Regulation (EU) 2025/2650.
strings.Origen registra cada parcela desde el ce: Origen captures every plot on a phone, even with no signal, checks it against satellite data and brings all the plots behind each shipment into one dossier, with the GeoJSON ready for TRACES. It works for the producer, the exporter and the importer, in any country.
strings.Qué campos entran en cada envío: el gran: Which fields go into each shipment: grain is mixed in silos and ports, and the EUDR does not allow offsetting with other fields.
strings.Qué plantaciones abastecieron cada lote,: Which plantations supplied each batch, even if the latex went through middlemen and processing plants.
strings.Qué plantaciones entran en cada lote de: Which plantations go into each batch of oil: the mill mixes fruit from many growers and the EUDR does not allow offsetting with other plots.

app_features: All 7 EUDR commodities with their HS codes: coffee, cocoa, oil palm, soy, rubber, wood (with species) and cattle
Plot capture on a phone, even offline: a point, or a polygon for plots over 4 ha, in any country
Bulk import of plots from Excel, CSV or GeoJSON
Checks against Hansen/Global Forest Watch, GLAD and RADD alerts (Landsat, Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1), WDPA and the EU JRC 2020 forest map
One dossier per shipment with TRACES-ready GeoJSON, SHA-256 fingerprint, QR code and Bitcoin timestamp (OpenTimestamps)
Segregation simulator and lot confidence score
Export of all data in open formats
